# KubeTEE

> KubeTEE is Bittensor subnet 90 (SN90): decentralized GPU clusters turned into a confidential AI factory, with inference and AI workloads running inside hardware-secured Trusted Execution Environments (Intel TDX, AMD SEV-SNP).

KubeTEE runs confidential inference today through an OpenAI-compatible gateway and sayGM. Workloads are isolated with Kata Containers and Confidential Containers; a nonce-bound hardware quote proves the guest measurement, and CoCo Trustee/KBS release secrets only to an attested guest. The site also publishes an on-chain SN28 -> SN90 alpha recycle dashboard.

## Pages

- [KubeTEE overview](/): what KubeTEE is, the four pillars, how a request moves from GPU cluster to attested inference, live status, roadmap, and FAQ.
- [SN28 -> SN90 recycle dashboard](/dashboard): every alpha recycle fill with its extrinsic, daily swap value in USD, and the raw JSON.
